changelog: Call Type Detection, Configuration, Alerts and Operations now share the same submenu height, spacing, typography, borders, hover, focus and active states.
Settings keeps its grouped scrollable rail while adopting the same height, radius and active treatment for consistency without losing density.
changelog_es: Call Type Detection, Configuration, Alerts y Operations comparten el mismo componente visual: altura, espaciado, tipografía, bordes, hover, foco y estado activ
Settings conserva su riel agrupado y desplazable, pero adopta la misma altura, radio y tratamiento activo para mantener consistencia sin perder densidad.
